title: German Potato Fritters
description: A classic German dish made with crispy potato fritters and a side of tangy applesauce. Perfect for a snack or light meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the grated potatoes and 1/2 cup of water. Let it sit for 5 minutes to allow the potatoes to release their excess moisture.
Squeeze out as much water as possible from the potato mixture using a cheesecloth or a clean dish towel.
In a separate bowl, mix together the eggs, salt, and pepper.
Add the egg mixture to the potato mixture and stir until well combined.
Heat a large non-stick skillet or griddle over medium-high heat.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the potato mixture into the skillet or griddle, flattening it slightly with a spatula.
Cook the fritters for 4-5 minutes on each side, or until they are golden brown and crispy.
Serve the fritters hot with a side of tangy applesauce or your favorite dipping sauce.
Optional: You can also coat the fritters with a mixture of flour, paprika, and garlic powder before frying for an extra crispy coating.
